== Information ==

This template is used to indicate commanders who were either captured or surrendered, and were subsequently [[Capital punishment|executed]]. Use in {{tlg|Infobox military conflict}} and similar infoboxes. 

== Usage ==

<code>{{tl|Executed}}</code> produces: [[File:Skull and Crossbones.svg|16px|Executed|link=executed]]
